endpoint.description: Base URL of the yy-Pixelle-Video service (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8000).

apiKey.description: Optional bearer token forwarded as Authorization header to the yy-Pixelle-Video service.

pollIntervalMs.description: Interval between task-status polls. Defaults to 5000 ms.

timeoutMs.description: Upper bound on total polling duration. Defaults to 50 minutes.

allowPrivateNetwork.description: Allow contacting private/loopback hosts. Required for local Pixelle service; defaults to true for loopback.
